annotations.title: A named person approves or rejects a proposal

description: Keyed. A named person approves or rejects a payment intent. The decision is kept with the time, the person and the proposal. An agent cannot approve alone. Nothing is sent.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

intent_id.description: The payment intent's id, from payment_intent.

person_name.description: Full name of the person deciding, e.g. 'Thandi Nkosi'. An agent cannot decide alone.

name: decide_intent
